description: A simple browser-based arcade game inspired by the classic Whac-A-Mole. The game challenges players to hit as many moles as possible within a limited time.
readme: # Whack-A-Mole ### Whac-A-Mole is a popular arcade redemption game. #### Quick Start: ##### Git clone https://github.com/JivkoJelev91/Whack-A-Mole ##### Run HTML file in the browser. ##### Enjoy! ![test](./pictures/game.png?raw=true "Optional Title")
